finance.title: Is there any outstanding finance on the car?
finance.hint: For example, a car loan, hire purchase (HP) or PCP agreement that isn't paid off yet.

vin.title: WHAT'S THE REG?
vin.hint: The number plate lets the buyer check the car's details and MOT history.
vin.note: It's on the front and rear number plates and on the V5C logbook. You can also skip this step.

location.note: No street address needed at this stage, and the postcode is optional.

finance_details.placeholder: e.g. PCP with about £5,000 left to pay

errors.required: Enter the town or city where the car is.

rear_right.tip: Stand at the rear right corner so the boot, rear lights, rear wheel and right side are in the frame.
